description: Exploit, as the second point of the coarse grid. On the E010 recipe, halve only the weight decay for all parameter groups (Muon conv filters and SGD groups), keeping the same decoupled or coupled form the code uses now. Everything else stays identical. Short runs with EMA may need less regularization than the 0.012 CIFAR-10 value.
